checks.name: derived grouped source
checks.sql: SELECT dt.customer_id, dt.total_spent FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS total_spent FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id) AS dt ORDER BY dt.total_spent DESC, dt.customer_id;

checks.name: derived join totals
checks.sql: SELECT c.name, dt.total_spent FROM customers c INNER JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS total_spent FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id) AS dt ON c.id = dt.customer_id ORDER BY dt.total_spent DESC, c.name;

checks.name: derived table alias required
checks.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders);
